doan: If he was sick doan yuh tink de nurse in de horspitral can write a letter even fuh a shillin' fuh he?
"But wha' kin de Lord do fo' yo' now yo' doan heah fum dat woofless vargybin?"
doat:
’Neath master-hands, from instruments defaced,—
And great souls, at one stroke, may do and doat.
doating:
Mere women, personal and passionate,
You give us doating mothers, and chaste wives,
Sublime Madonnas, and enduring saints!
